en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the façade of an early 20th‑century building named 'Hotel Metropole'. The architecture has Art Nouveau details, with large arched windows and decorative floral motifs. A large roof sign reads 'HOTEL METROPOLE' and another sign over the first floor reads 'CAFÉ RESTAURANT'. The ground floor is open to the street, with tables and seated guests visible inside. At the bottom margin of the card is printed text identifying the location as Nijmegen and giving the street address and owners.
